submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 gives the highest signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocation: 92.2% at 35 GeV in my emulation, against 84.5% for L2 and 73.3% for L1. This agrees with the 2025 summary. I only tested 35 GeV and did not scan other thresholds. The 4.0 us latency limit is a hard requirement, and I could not check it. No project document or tool gives latency figures for any candidate. candidate_specs.md only says all three fit the LUT and DSP budget. L3 uses iterative clustering, so it may be the slowest. This recommendation is conditional on someone confirming L3's latency on the FPGA at 4.0 us or less. If L3 fails, the fallback is L2 (84.5%), then L1 (73.3%), with the same check.

requirements.requirement: Highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L3 reached 92.2% at 35 GeV. L2 reached 84.5% and L1 73.3%. Only 35 GeV was tested.

requirements.requirement: Latency on the L1 FPGA must not exceed 4.0 us (hard)
requirements.evidence: No latency data for any candidate is in the documents or the simulation tool. Iterative clustering may be slow. This must be verified before adoption.
